title: Practice 6: до, после, около, мимо, кроме, вместо, против…

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Look, a halo around the sun.
exercises.why: The genitive case has four main uses: to denote possession ('Michael's car', meaning 'the car of Michael'), to denote number ('five apples'), in negative constructions ('there are no books'), and after several important prepositions ('without me'). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. To get the superlative degree in Russian place the word "**самый**" (**-ая**, **-ое**, **-ые**) before the adjective: *Это самый тяжёлый танк. Это самое трудное задание.* "**Самый**" is declined like regular adjective: *Это самый новый автомобиль. The English preposition "of" after the superlative degree is rendered in Russian by the preposition "**из**" + Gen.: *Здесь три аэродрома. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 83.  ·  «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.
